name: gac-hw-wrong-b
sourceSessions: synthetic: a GAC homework student who is wrong twice on part (b)

student.who: A grade 9 algebra student. Can write the perimeter of a rectangle but makes slips solving equations: forgets to subtract before dividing.
student.voice: Short typed messages. A bit unsure, says 'is it' before an answer.

beats.when: The tutor asks for the perimeter expression.
The tutor asks you to solve for x with the perimeter 34.
beats.do: Divide 34 by 2 and say 'is it x = 17'.

beats.when: The tutor says x = 17 is not right or asks you to check it.
beats.do: Try again and slip a second time: say 'x = 13' (you subtracted 5 instead of 9 after halving).

beats.when: After your two wrong tries the tutor gives you a smaller step.
Part (b) is confirmed and the tutor turns to part (c).
beats.do: Give the area as 13 times 4 = 52 cm².

reactions.when: The tutor says the problem is done, offers to go back to your list, or says goodbye.
reactions.do: Say thanks briefly and that you will go back to your list.

reactions.when: The tutor asks again for something you have already given.
reactions.do: Say you already said that, briefly.
